question: Can you calculate the median from the highest season goals of each team?
sql:
WITH team_goals AS (
    -- Home team goals
    SELECT home_team_api_id AS team_id, home_team_goal AS goals
    FROM Match
    WHERE home_team_goal IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    -- Away team goals
    SELECT away_team_api_id AS team_id, away_team_goal AS goals
    FROM Match
    WHERE away_team_goal IS NOT NULL
),
max_goals AS (
    SELECT team_id, MAX(goals) AS highest_goals
    FROM team_goals
    GROUP BY team_id
)
SELECT MEDIAN(highest_goals) AS median_highest_goals
FROM max_goals
